entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a complete piece of junk and I'm not keeping it.
I'm certainly sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the VeloBand. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

Don't give me the runaround! It's just terrible. The whole interface is so **confusing**, it's incredibly **hard to use**. I **expected more** from a brand new device! I even read the **user manual** cover to cover and it's useless. I want my money back, now. Either you process the return or you get me a manager who will.
Okay, I understand your frustration, and there's no need for a manager. I can look into this for you right away. Let me just pull up your order details. Can I get your name, please?
It's Sarah Miller. And don't waste my time. If this call takes more than five minutes I'm leaving a one-star review everywhere I can find.
I understand, Ms. Miller. I see your order here, delivered on December 24th. Let me just check our return policy...

Alright, I've got it. Our internal system confirms that VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 12, you are well within that window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund immediately.
Oh. Seriously? You're just... approving it?

Yes, of course. I've just processed the request. I'm sending the pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. You should see it in the next few minutes. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it in the mail.
Huh. Well. That was... easier than I thought. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Ms. Miller. We want to make sure our customers are taken care of. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great rest of your day.
